name: Artifacts
summary: Turn session output into live web pages on claude.ai that you can keep private or share.
what: Claude can publish what it makes, such as a report, chart or small app, as an interactive page at a private claude.ai address. You decide whether to share it with your organization or publicly, and people can leave comments that Claude can answer.

impact.title: Share results easily
impact.detail: Send a link instead of a screenshot or file.

impact.title: Live content
impact.detail: Pages can pull fresh data through connectors.

impact.title: Feedback in place
impact.detail: Comment threads sit on the page itself.

howItWorks: Ask Claude in plain words to make a page.
Run /artifacts to list or reopen your artifacts.
Pages start private; you choose who can see them.
Needs a claude.ai login on a Pro, Max, Ultra, Team or Enterprise plan.
Turn it off with enableArtifact set to false in /config.

events.note: First changelog mention of artifact publishing.
